info.title: E-Learning Backend API
info.description: Course/Lesson visibility and administrative metadata API. Commercial brands: Medway, Elite, Nexus. Academic institutions: BUC, Delta. Student and admin bearers have separate persisted authorization boundaries. The private app schema is not exposed through Supabase Data API.

servers.description: Current API base, including its mounted prefix

mediaStatus.description: no_media when there is no visible resource; pending_media for published metadata only. ready is reserved and is never emitted by this phase.

lessonsWithMedia.description: No playable media is delivered in this phase.
No playable media is delivered in this phase.

resourceCount.description: Catalogue metadata count; no content delivery rights or storage location.

AdminStudentReadItem.description: Authorized administrative student read. Full name is private admin data; email and student code are masked. Phone, device, session, activity, and access facts remain null or empty until an approved source exists.

academicInstitution.description: Academic institution such as BUC or Delta; never a commercial brand.

AdminBearerAuth.description: Real admin access token with persisted admin permission.

StudentBearerAuth.description: Real student access token with active student membership and placement. An identity with an admin profile is rejected.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Optional when the verified student has one eligible membership. Required when multiple memberships exist. Never grants scope. BUC/Delta are institutions, not brands.

get.description: Published course structure scoped to the verified student's active commercial-brand membership and academic institution/level/semester. No enrollment or paid entitlement is fabricated. An identity with a persisted admin profile is rejected; admin preview is not provided by these endpoints. No media delivery URLs are returned.

200.description: Visible structure; an empty list is valid.

400.description: Invalid/repeated/unsupported parameter, or brand selection needed.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or invalid bearer token.

403.description: No active student membership and valid academic placement in this scope, or identity belongs to an admin profile.

404.description: Course missing or outside the student's visible scope.

503.description: Real authentication or database reads are unavailable. No mock fallback.

get.description: Private metadata only; no upload, storage locator, entitlement, or delivery authorization. Video metadata is forced to draft on create and update; no approval endpoint exists. Writes temporarily require admin.platform.admin.write; reads require admin.platform.admin.read. A separate permission migration is deferred. PATCH requires the current expectedVersion; each mutation records M4A receipt and audit evidence. This is a GET read operation and never requires Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Real course structure; empty array when no records exist

404.description: Scoped course or parent not found

409.description: Version, sort order, or idempotency conflict
